crownPassive.name: Winged sandals
crownPassive.text: Your heroes have +1 Guard in rounds you hold the Fate token, and +1 Speed in rounds you don't.

bond.name: Gorgon's bane
bond.text: +1 Attack for each Beast on the board, on either side.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Mirrored shield
actions.text: The first attack aimed at Perseus this round is reflected: the attacker takes the damage instead. Not Speed dependent: if chosen, it is up before anyone acts. Once per fight.

actions.name: Medusa's head
actions.text: An enemy hero is turned to stone: it takes no actions this round and has +2 Guard. Like every stopping effect, it can't stop the same hero two rounds running. Once per fight.
